title: Compression skills
body: Hand position. Chest compressions. Letting the chest rise between presses.

support.body: Learn the technique, watch a demo, then practise together.

title: Start with your hands
body: Centre of the chest, on the lower half of the breastbone.

support.body: Rest the firm base of your palm, just above the wrist, here. Stack your other hand on top.
Press down, then release your weight so the chest can rise fully before the next compression.

title: Take your time
body: Your place is saved. Questions are welcome.

title: Watch the hand contact point
body: Watch the overview, then try the starting position.

title: Set your starting position
body: Place both hands on the manikin’s chest and prepare for a short practice round.

title: Adjust your hands
body: Move the firm base of your lower palm up onto the lower half of the breastbone.

title: Practice complete
body: You completed a short practice round. Review the hand placement whenever you need a reminder.
